scope: Six-file UI-only native Add block candidate; actor/API/lifecycle and Inspector quote preservation
observations: AnyNativeTextBlockKind is Sendable and maps only native types admitted by the unchanged creation intent.
Document/per-block menus call the same guarded mutation path; actual authority checks, protected creator journal, current snapshot placement and native readback remain intact.
Paragraph diagnostics retain original conditions and payload; quote retains exact escaped provider text, provider direction, natural alignment and afterLastVisibleBlock placement.
Native marker/import field keys agree with the new catalog. Distinct heading levels and list variants have distinct intent fingerprints.
limitations: Source review only; no Apple typecheck, Swift/XCTest, simulator, native service or visual execution.

Existing AnyNativeEditor.attributed selects title2 for every heading regardless of style.level; new stored heading levels do not yet have different base font sizes in this renderer. Code also starts at the existing body font before run traits. This is a source-observed presentation limitation, not a runtime finding.
